import requests, json, uuid, datetime
base='http://localhost:3000'; maya='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'; jordan='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb'; priya='cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc'; sam='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
def post(path,user,body,key=None): return requests.post(base+path,headers={'X-Demo-User':user,'Idempotency-Key':key or str(uuid.uuid4()),'Content-Type':'application/json'},json=body,timeout=15)
ov=requests.get(base+'/api/overview',headers={'X-Demo-User':maya}).json(); units={u['asset_tag']:u for u in ov['units']}
checks=[]
key=str(uuid.uuid4()); body={'unit_id':units['L-118']['id'],'start_date':'2026-09-08','end_date':'2026-09-14'}
r=post('/api/quotes',maya,body,key); checks.append(('7-day quote',r.status_code,r.json()))
r2=post('/api/quotes',maya,body,key); checks.append(('idempotent replay',r2.status_code,r2.json()==r.json()))
checks.append(('missing identity',requests.get(base+'/api/overview').status_code))
checks.append(('role escalation denied',post('/api/units/'+units['L-118']['id']+'/manage',sam,{'status':'RETIRED'}).status_code))
checks.append(('on-hold denied',post('/api/quotes',priya,{'unit_id':units['T-012']['id'],'start_date':'2026-09-08','end_date':'2026-09-09'}).status_code))
checks.append(('expired cert denied',post('/api/quotes',jordan,{'unit_id':units['D-004']['id'],'start_date':'2026-09-08','end_date':'2026-09-09'}).status_code))
checks.append(('bad date format',post('/api/quotes',maya,{'unit_id':units['L-118']['id'],'start_date':'2026/09/08','end_date':'2026-09-09'}).status_code))
checks.append(('15 days denied',post('/api/quotes',maya,{'unit_id':units['L-118']['id'],'start_date':'2026-09-08','end_date':'2026-09-22'}).status_code))
for c in checks: print(c)
q=r.json().get('quote',{}); print('math',q.get('base_cents'),q.get('discount_cents'),q.get('rental_cents'),q.get('weekend_cents'),q.get('tax_cents'),q.get('deposit_cents'),q.get('total_cents'))
